# Vanté Agency

> Digital studio from Kosovo. We design and engineer premium web experiences for brands across Europe and worldwide.

## About

Vanté Agency (https://vanteagency.dev) is a professional web development and UI/UX design studio founded by Lorik Jashari. Based in Kosovo, serving clients in Switzerland, Europe, and internationally.

## Services

- Web Development
- UI/UX Design
- Business Websites
- Landing Pages
- Backend Systems
- Performance Optimization
- Custom Digital Solutions
